scripts.build: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-preview.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.cloudflare:build: npm run build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs && node scripts/build-cloudflare.mjs
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run cloudflare:build && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production
